== Template:Item/SpellDetails ==

Displays full spell details inline for item effects (procs, consumables, auras). This template handles all 40+ spell fields automatically, only showing relevant information.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Description
|-
| '''spell_icon''' || Spell icon image filename (optional, displays on left)
|-
| '''spell_name''' || Spell name (default: "Spell Effect")
|-
| '''spell_level''' || Required level to use
|-
| '''spell_duration_ticks''' || Duration in ticks (×3 for seconds)
|-
| '''spell_type''' || Spell type (Damage, Heal, Buff, etc.)
|-
| '''spell_line''' || Spell line/school
|-
| '''target_damage''' || Damage dealt
|-
| '''target_healing''' || Healing amount
|-
| '''damage_type''' || Resist type
|-
| '''cast_time''' || Cast time in seconds
|-
| '''cooldown''' || Cooldown in seconds
|-
| '''spell_range''' || Range value
|}

Plus stat modifiers (hp, ac, mana, str, dex, end, agi, wis, int, cha, mr, er, pr, vr), special effects (movement_speed, damage_shield, haste, percent_lifesteal, atk_roll_modifier, resonate_chance), and crowd control flags (lifetap, group_effect, stun_target, charm_target, root_target, taunt_spell).

=== Examples ===

'''Direct Damage Proc (e.g., Cinder of Birth):'''
<pre>
{{Item/SpellDetails
|spell_icon=Brax's Rage.png
|spell_name=Brax's Rage
|spell_level=25
|spell_duration_ticks=0
|spell_type=Damage
|spell_line=Direct_Damage
|target_damage=455
|damage_type=Magic
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/SpellDetails
|spell_icon=Brax's Rage.png
|spell_name=Brax's Rage
|spell_level=25
|spell_duration_ticks=0
|spell_type=Damage
|spell_line=Direct_Damage
|target_damage=455
|damage_type=Magic
}}
